activate.description: Bring Maps to the foreground without claiming a rendered page.

open-frame.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps frame URL.

open-search.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps search URL.

open-place.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps place URL.

open-look-around.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps Look Around URL.

open-directions.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps directions-preview URL.

start-navigation.description: Declare one explicit policy-validated Unified Maps navigation URL.

open-guides.description: Declare the policy-validated Unified Maps guides URL.

open-report-problem.description: Declare one policy-validated Unified Maps report-sheet URL without submission.

open-link.description: Declare one exact Maps link after policy validation and canonicalization.

navigate-candidate.description: Review one exact navigation-start candidate before sealed physical execution.

report-problem-candidate.description: Review one exact report-sheet candidate without submitting it.

requires_confirmation: the exact candidate route, parameters, and transient effect were reviewed
prohibited: dispatching candidate or incompatible route commands through production maps calls
starting guidance except through an explicitly authorized navigate candidate test
sharing locations or routes, changing permissions, editing guides or saved places, payments, authentication, or protected confirmations
retries after dispatch or treating CoreDevice acceptance as route compatibility evidence
safety.uncertain_outcome: A URL may already have reached Maps and affected Recents when the response is lost. Treat the result as uncertain, inspect visible state with the user, and do not replay it.

permissions: Maps location permission only when a request uses current location

data_access: explicit map, place, route, guide, report-sheet, or link values supplied by the caller
current location when Maps already has permission and a request implies it
data_sent: strictly validated Apple Maps URL values handled by Apple Maps
privacy.retention: The integration stores no route values. Maps may retain searches and destinations in Recents under the user’s Maps settings.
privacy.notes: The executable URL policy targets com.apple.Maps exactly and caps canonical URLs at 2,048 UTF-8 bytes. For product iPad17,1, hardware J817AP, OS build 23G83, frame, search/show, place, Look Around, directions preview, guides, and validated links are proven; navigation start and report-a-problem remain explicit candidates. Route compatibility comes from the separate exact-profile authority, not source documentation or dispatch acceptance. Open remains ordinary app activation.
